blocks.text: Di pelajaran 9 kamu bilang apa yang sedang terjadi sekarang: I am reading. Sekarang kamu bercerita apa yang sedang terjadi pada suatu saat di masa lalu: «waktu itu aku sedang membaca komik», «aku sedang membersihkan sepatu bot waktu kamu menelepon», «dia mencium bunga sementara aku bicara».

examples.en: I was reading a comic book.
examples.translation: Waktu itu aku sedang membaca komik.

examples.en: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.
examples.translation: Mereka sedang menyusun puzzle.

examples.en: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.
examples.translation: Aku sedang membersihkan sepatu botku waktu kamu menelepon.

examples.en: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.
examples.translation: Dia mencium bunga sementara aku sedang bicara.

blocks.text: Kita cukup bilang «waktu itu» dan «sedang». Bahasa Inggris perlu dua bagian: was atau were, dan -ing. Ini pelajaran 9 yang dipindah ke masa lalu: am / is / are jadi was / were. I was reading — bukan I reading atau I am reading.

examples.en: I was reading a comic book.
examples.translation: Waktu itu aku sedang membaca komik.

examples.en: She was using a colouring book.
examples.translation: Dia sedang mewarnai buku mewarnai.

examples.en: I was cooking fried rice.
examples.translation: Aku sedang memasak nasi goreng.

examples.en: We were eating a spring roll.
examples.translation: Kami sedang makan lumpia.

examples.en: They were watching the soap bubbles.
examples.translation: Mereka sedang melihat gelembung sabun.

fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.

fixes.wrong: They was doing a jigsaw puzzle.
fixes.right: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.

drill.why: Dengan they di masa lalu — were; -ing sudah ada.

blocks.text: «Tidak» seperti biasa, sesudah was atau were: I wasn't playing, they weren't watching. wasn't adalah was not, weren't adalah were not. -ing tetap ada.

examples.en: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.
examples.translation: Waktu itu aku tidak sedang main di istana balon.

examples.en: I wasn't writing in the homework diary.
examples.translation: Aku tidak sedang menulis di buku PR.

examples.en: I wasn't watching the robin.
examples.translation: Aku tidak sedang melihat burung robin.

fixes.wrong: I not playing on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

fixes.wrong: I didn't playing on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

blocks.text: Kita bertanya tanpa mengubah urutan. Bahasa Inggris memindahkan was / were ke depan: Were you playing in the paddling pool? Tidak pakai did: Did you playing itu salah.

examples.en: Were you playing in the paddling pool?
examples.translation: Waktu itu kamu sedang main di kolam karet?

examples.en: Was he jumping on the trampoline?
examples.translation: Dia sedang lompat di trampolin?

examples.en: Were you using the workbook?
examples.translation: Kamu sedang memakai buku latihan?

examples.en: Was he watching the owl?
examples.translation: Dia sedang melihat burung hantu?

fixes.wrong: Did you playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

fixes.wrong: You were playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

drill.question: Tanyakan apakah waktu itu dia sedang melihat burung hantu. Mana yang benar?
drill.explain: Dengan -ing, pertanyaan dimulai dengan was atau were, bukan did.

blocks.text: Bentuk ini dipakai untuk menggambar latar: apa yang sedang dilakukan orang saat cerita dimulai. I was changing a flat tyre — «aku sedang mengganti ban kempes». Ini bukan kejadian tersendiri, tapi sesuatu yang sedang berlangsung.

examples.en: I was changing a flat tyre.
examples.translation: Aku sedang mengganti ban kempes.

examples.en: He was checking the windscreen wiper.
examples.translation: Dia sedang mengecek wiper kaca depan.

examples.en: We were cleaning the rear-view mirror.
examples.translation: Kami sedang membersihkan spion tengah.

examples.en: She was packing the nappy bag.
examples.translation: Dia sedang mengemas tas popok.

blocks.text: Kalau sesuatu terjadi di tengah kegiatan: kegiatannya — was / were + -ing, kejadiannya — bentuk lampau biasa sesudah when: I was cleaning my boots when you called. Teleponnya singkat dan memotong kegiatan.

examples.en: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.
examples.translation: Aku sedang membersihkan sepatu botku waktu kamu menelepon.

examples.en: She was packing her ballet flats when I called.
examples.translation: Dia sedang mengemas sepatu balet waktu aku menelepon.

examples.en: We were looking for an insole when you arrived.
examples.translation: Kami sedang mencari sol dalam waktu kamu datang.

examples.en: She was drawing a piece of driftwood when I arrived.
examples.translation: Dia sedang menggambar kayu hanyut waktu aku datang.

fixes.wrong: I cleaned my ankle boots when you were calling.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

fixes.wrong: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you call.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

drill.prompt: Katakan: «Kami sedang mencari sol dalam waktu kamu datang».

blocks.text: while artinya «sementara». Dipakai kalau dua kegiatan berlangsung bersamaan, dan kedua bagian memakai was / were + -ing: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.

examples.en: I was looking up while you were taking a photo.
examples.translation: Aku melihat ke atas sementara kamu memotret.

examples.en: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.
examples.translation: Dia mencium bunga sementara aku sedang bicara.

examples.en: We were giggling while he was telling the story.
examples.translation: Kami cekikikan sementara dia bercerita.

examples.en: I was cutting celery while you were cooking.
examples.translation: Aku memotong seledri sementara kamu memasak.

blocks.text: Kita sering pakai «waktu» atau «saat» untuk keduanya. Bahasa Inggris membedakan: kejadian singkat yang memotong — when + lampau biasa: when you called. Kegiatan panjang yang bersamaan — while + was / were + -ing.

examples.en: We were watching a wasp when you called.
examples.translation: Kami sedang melihat tawon waktu kamu menelepon.

examples.en: I was watching a butterfly while you were taking a photo.
examples.translation: Aku melihat kupu-kupu sementara kamu memotret.

examples.en: I was turning around when you called my name.
examples.translation: Aku sedang menoleh waktu kamu memanggil namaku.

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.

fixes.wrong: They was doing a jigsaw puzzle.
fixes.right: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.

fixes.wrong: I didn't playing on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

fixes.wrong: Did you playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

fixes.wrong: I cleaned my ankle boots when you were calling.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

blocks.text: «Sedang» di masa lalu punya dua bagian: was / were dan -ing. Kejadian singkat yang memotong — lampau biasa sesudah when. Did tidak dipakai dengan -ing.
Sedang berlangsung di masa lalu — was / were + -ing. «Tidak» — wasn't / weren't. Bertanya — Was…? Were…? Memotong — when + lampau biasa. Bersamaan — while + was / were + -ing.

examples.en: I was filling a spray bottle.
examples.translation: Aku sedang mengisi botol semprot.

examples.en: Were you taking a photo of the woodpecker?
examples.translation: Waktu itu kamu sedang memotret burung pelatuk?

examples.en: I was looking at a starfish when you called.
examples.translation: Aku sedang melihat bintang laut waktu kamu menelepon.

examples.en: I was using a glue stick while you were drawing.
examples.translation: Aku memakai lem stik sementara kamu menggambar.
